title_cyr: Море што си бевме големото друштво
title_latin: More što si bevme golemoto društvo
title_en: Hey, what a big company we were
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Маркој Кули is my reading of Marko's Towers above Prilep. 'прле' is dialect for roasted peppers (my reading).

lines.cyr: Мори што си бевме големото друштво,
lines.lat: Mori što si bevme golemoto društvo,
lines.en: Hey, what a big company we were,
a big company, all of us drinkers.

lines.cyr: Кој војник појде, кој в' затвор ојде,
lines.lat: Koj vojnik pojde, koj v' zatvor ojde,
lines.en: One went to the army, one went off to prison,

lines.cyr: кој граница фати - назад не се врати.
lines.lat: koj granica fati - nazad ne se vrati.
lines.en: one crossed the border and never came back.

lines.cyr: Море ако дај Бог да се собериме,
lines.lat: More ako daj Bog da se soberime,
lines.en: Hey, if God grants that we get together,

lines.cyr: горе Маркој Кули прле ќе печиме,
lines.lat: gore Markoj Kuli prle ḱe pečime,
lines.en: up at Marko's Towers we'll roast peppers,

lines.cyr: Прле ќе печиме, вино ќе пијаме,
lines.lat: Prle ḱe pečime, vino ḱe pijame,
lines.en: We'll roast peppers, we'll drink wine,

lines.cyr: вино ќе пијаме, моми ќе љубиме.
lines.lat: vino ḱe pijame, momi ḱe ljubime.
lines.en: we'll drink wine, we'll kiss girls.
Macedonian girls, all of them from Prilep.
